data.narrative:
Fire Point is a Series A–stage Defense & Security company founded by Denys Shtilerman, Iryna Terekh, and Yehor Skalyha, with undisclosed funding anchored by the Ukrainian Ministry of Defense. The valuation analysis draws on a comparables universe of 10 private and 2 public peers in the same sector and stage, including Stark Defence, Singularity, NODA AI, Anduril Industries, and Helsing.

The peer-median method, applied across 3 same-sector, same-stage private comparables, yields a valuation of $400M. The peer sample spans a range from $125M (NODA AI) to $4.0B (Stark Defence), reflecting material dispersion in the Defense & Security Series A segment. This wide range reflects heterogeneity in technology maturity, customer concentration, and geopolitical positioning within the cohort. The median of $400M sits materially above the floor of $125M, suggesting Fire Point's positioning aligns with mid-to-upper-quartile precedent in this stage and sector.

The triangulated valuation range is $340M to $460M, with a median of $400M. This analysis is constrained by reliance on a single quantitative method; deeper triangulation through revenue multiples or customer-based metrics would strengthen conviction. Key uncertainties include Fire Point's revenue run rate, customer concentration risk (given the Ukrainian MoD anchor relationship), and comparability of the peer set given the specialized nature of defense applications and geopolitical exposure.
